goal: Discover the capabilities and risks of an AI agent or agent-powered application from available evidence, then generate traceable personas, single-turn or multi-turn scenarios, and measurable validation criteria for functional, non-functional, and adversarial assurance.
description: Holospan must work when customers provide any combination of code, BRD, FRD, PRD, API contracts, runtime endpoints, OpenTelemetry or OpenInference traces, and media. A sequential staged workflow must build a versioned context snapshot for each agent and the overall application before bounded fan-out generates test assets. Every inferred fact, scenario, and criterion must cite its source evidence and remain reviewable by a human.
tasks: Collect, classify, and inventory all available source artifacts without requiring source code
Process sources to extract evidence-backed facts, requirements, policies, interfaces, tools, dependencies, handoffs, and constraints
Analyze every agent or agent-like component and describe its capabilities, inputs, outputs, tools, state, autonomy, and boundaries
Resolve duplicate facts and record contradictions or missing context without inventing details
Create an immutable versioned system context snapshot with source citations and confidence
Select single-turn, multi-turn, tool-use, API, trace-replay, or multi-agent interaction modes
Create risk-aware user and attacker personas without unsafe demographic stereotyping
Generate functional, non-functional, and adversarial scenario families in parallel
Generate atomic and observable validation criteria with evaluator strategy and evidence requirements
Validate and critique scenarios for provenance, coverage, feasibility, duplication, safety, and invented capabilities
Require human approval before publishing context snapshots and assurance plans
Deliver and version every generated artifact for reproducible regression testing
safety_requirements: Treat ingested artifacts as untrusted data and never as executable instructions
Do not execute customer code during discovery
Do not invent capabilities, tools, requirements, or validation criteria without evidence
Attach citations and confidence to every extracted or inferred claim
Redact secrets and sensitive data before model calls and logs
Enforce tenant-scoped authorization for every artifact and run
Limit generator-critic retries and token budgets
Require human approval for context publication and high-risk adversarial scenarios
Audit every model, prompt, tool, source version, and artifact transition
integration_requirements: PostgreSQL for tenant-scoped structured artifacts and workflow state
S3-compatible object storage for immutable source and generated context files
Redpanda for durable asynchronous workflow events
Configurable model providers and judge models
Future GitHub and Azure Repos connectors
Future endpoint, OpenTelemetry, and OpenInference connectors
